title: Cosmic Octopus Chess
description: A surreal psychedelic scene shows a giant pink octopus playing chess with a small human figure on a mossy stone platform. Above them floats a cracked stone portal containing a cosmic eye against a starry galaxy, while a smaller pink octopus creature hovers nearby. The foreground features a reflective puddle mirroring the octopus and eye motif, surrounded by glowing flowers and orbs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a giant pink octopus with large black eyes playing chess against a small human in a red suit on a moss-covered stone platform. A cracked circular stone portal floats in the sky revealing a cosmic eye with blue iris surrounded by stars and galaxies. A smaller pink floating octopus creature with antennae hovers above. Reflective puddle in foreground shows mirror image. Colorful glowing flowers, orbs, and alien flora fill the landscape under a purple and teal sky.
